description: This PHP file defines the class OAuth2Tokens, which models OAuth 2.0 token data within the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties representing token attributes, a summary method, and a customized query creation method for listing tokens with access control.

classes.name: OAuth2Tokens
classes.description: A class extending SugarBean, representing OAuth 2.0 tokens stored in the database with methods for token management and query customization.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a brief summary string based on the token's ID.

methods.name: getNowDateString
methods.description: Returns the current date/time as a string, using the database's time conversion.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to generate a list query for OAuth2Tokens, adding access control based on user permissions.
